p: tenth year of Zedekiah king of: So that Jeremiah had now prophesied from the thirteenth year of Josiah to the last year save one of Zedekiah's reign, which was almost forty years.
I visit him: Till I take Zedekiah away by death: for he will not die by the sword as in Jer 34:4.
Buy for thee my field that: By which was meant that the people would return again out of captivity and enjoy their possessions and vineyards as in Jer 32:15,44.
to buy it: Because he was next of the kindred, as in Ru 4:4.
field: Of the possession of the Levites, read Le 25:32.

shekels of silver: Which amounts to about ten shillings six pence in our money if this shekel were the common shekel, see Geneva "Ge 23:15", for the shekel of the temple was of double value, and ten pieces of silver were half a shekel, for twenty made the shekel.

according to the law and custom: According to the custom the instrument or evidence was sealed up with the common seal and a copy of it remained which contained the same in effect but was left open to be seen if anything should be called into doubt.
vessel: And so to hide them in the ground, that they might be reserved as a token of their deliverance.

children after them: Because the wicked are subject to the curse of God, he shows that their posterity who by nature are under this malediction will be punished both for their own wickedness and that the iniquity of their fathers which is likewise in them, will be also avenged on their head.
Who hast set signs and wonders: Meaning that his miracles in delivering his people would never be forgotten.
mounts: The word signifies anything that is cast up, as a mount or rampart, and is also used for engines of war, which were laid on a high place to shoot into a city before guns were in use.

flesh: That is, of every creature: who as they are his work, so does he govern and guide them as pleases him, by which he shows that as he is the author of their captivity for their sins, so will he for his mercies be their redeemer to restore them again to liberty.
youth: From the time that I brought them out of Egypt and made them my people and called them my firstborn.
rising early and teaching them: 2Ch 36:15,Isa 65:2,Jer 7:13,13;3,26;5,29:19,35:14,44:4.
places of Baal: That is, the altars which were made to offer sacrifices to their idols on.
son of Hinnom: Read Jer 7:31, 2Ki 21:4,6.
pass through the fire to Molech: Read 2Ki 16:3.
therefore thus saith the LORD: Read Jer 30:16.
one heart: One consent and one religion, as in Eze 11:19,36:26.
covenant with them: Read Jer 31:1-33:26.
fields for money: This is the declaration of that which was spoken of in Jer 32:8.
